Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.ott

Class PhonePageController

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.ott.PhonePageController
All Implemented Interfaces:
PhonePageApi
@Controller public class PhonePageController extends Object implements PhonePageApi
Serves the phone account page and the session-protected form posts it uses, as the contract apis/auth-server/web-pages/auth-server-pages-v1.yaml describes them through the generated PhonePageApi. A browser page has a session, not a bearer token, so it cannot call the REST API (/api/account/phone, which ApiSecurityConfig keeps bearer-only); the forms call the same use cases instead, with the same limits, and each answers by redirecting back to the page (post/redirect/get) with the outcome in the status parameter. The number is shown masked, as the REST API answers it.
